snippet.title: Project U-Ta-Hi-Me - Shining Grace (Normal)
snippet.description:
'Shining Grace' by IOSYS played in Project U-Ta-Hi-Me on Normal difficulty, using the Standard skin.

I've had my eyes on Project U-Ta-Hi-Me for a while now, ever since it initially released on October fifth. Unfortunately, the game isn't on physical media and can only be purchased as a downloadable game, or so I think. After a while of waiting for it to be available somewhere with Paypal, I finally purchased it yesterday!

Project U-Ta-Hi-Me is, as I see it, the 'Audiosurf' of shmups. The game generates stages based on your very own music (.MP3 or .WAV) and includes a Noise at the end, or more commonly speaking, a boss. I don't know how many boss variations there are yet, but there ought to be plenty. There's also a bunch of different skins for the stages which can be unlocked by playing songs and such, as well as a bunch of skins currently marked as "Coming Soon...", which leads me to believe they will be added in a future patch.

To show the game I've done four runs using the four IOSYS tracks provided in the game. Sure.. I could of went and played some other bands, but I figured that for a showing the game I'd stick to the four tracks provided.

Track: Shining Grace
By: IOSYS

Project U-Ta-Hi-Me Official Website: http://www.giza10.com/soft/utahime/
IOSYS Official Website: http://www.iosysos.com/
